reviewer: Claude (independent read-only artifact and packet delta review; did not build or assemble the candidate)
verdict: trackpad-input-trace-candidate-001 binds the reviewed passive trace and nothing else. The RAM disk, its record and mapping are byte-identical to shared-shell-live-candidate-001. source.patch is live001's patch plus the reviewed input-trace.patch. The new KC differs from live001's only inside the PDM1SPIHID member and the prelink KC identifier. The bundle's imports equal the qualified T2 bundle's, and the new functions call only IOLog, memset, dlsp_crc16 and their own helpers. This does not qualify or authorize a boot. Root is the only hardware actor after the gates.

checks.P1_manifest: PASS. All four manifest sizes and sha256 values match the files. source_pins, target and purpose equal live001's. offline-inspection.json equals a fresh normal_image.verify_manifest report.
checks.P2_ram_identical: PASS. ramdisk.img, ramdisk.record.json and mapping.json are byte-identical to live001's. runtime_payload_changes is empty. The live001 userland (libSystem 9fc03c87, frontend fda83680, app 8003ec64) is therefore carried unchanged.
checks.P3_source_patch_delta: PASS. The first 8267 lines of the new source.patch are byte-identical to live001's 1c993138. The rest is one blank line, the header '# COMPONENT original passive device2 Input trace layered after frozen T2', and input-trace.patch (a35117e6) byte for byte. No other source change is bound.
checks.P4_bundle: PASS. The SDK executable on disk hashes to 0d01a77a. Its 378 undefined symbols are identical to the qualified T2 bundle 72ba1228. The defined-symbol delta is exactly m1tp_trace_init, m1tp_trace_announce, m1tp_trace_select, m1tp_trace_hex (+ its digits table), the static count helper and PDM1SPIHID::traceTrackpad.
checks.P5_no_forbidden_new_ops: PASS (binary level). Resolved call targets: traceTrackpad calls m1tp_trace_select, m1tp_trace_hex and _IOLog (three call sites through stub 0xe808); m1tp_trace_select calls _dlsp_crc16, count and _memset (stub 0xe97c); m1tp_trace_init calls _memset; m1tp_trace_announce and m1tp_trace_hex call nothing. No writePacket, request, timer, sleep, allocation or new import is reachable from the new code.
checks.P6_kc_member_binding: PASS. Both KCs have the same 50 fileset members in the same order with the same entry file offsets. Section offsets are entry-relative: reading them that way, the KC PDM1SPIHID member's __TEXT,__text (47472 B), __cstring (4722 B) and __const (322 B) equal the bundle's, while a global reading does not. This confirms root's corrected reader. 48 members are identical in every section's bytes, size and address. com.apple.kernel differs only in __PRELINK_INFO and the __PRELINK_TEXT umbrella that spans member text; its own code sections are identical.
checks.P7_kc_byte_attribution: PASS. Every one of the 91,463 differing bytes between the base and new KC lies in PDM1SPIHID's own __TEXT (47,923), __DATA_CONST (122), __DATA (6) or __LINKEDIT (43,392) ranges, except 20 bytes in __PRELINK_INFO, which are the base64 _PrelinkKCID value in the prelink plist. No other prelink plist byte changed. PDM1SPIHID's __kalloc_type and __mod_init_func keep their sizes, so no allocation type or initializer was added.
checks.P8_packet_record: PASS. build-record.json keeps live001's top-level key set and changes only build identity, the components and source_components, desktop_test_mode (PASSIVE_TRACKPAD_DECLARED_INPUT_RAW_TRACE_NO_MODE_WRITES), evidence_rule, hardware_gate, not_claimed, kernel_sha256 (f8825e97) and source_patch_sha256 (407e3310). All 40 source_components match live files. The seven new components (KC record, SDK record, contract 5490927e, criteria 9477795a, the 25-input manifest, source-validation db00bae8 and the source review ea89cb40) all match live bytes. No component was removed. evidence_rule equals reports/sprint-010/trackpad-input-trace-qualification-criteria-001.json. host_input_sources are unchanged from live001 and match live files.
checks.P9_host_opt_ins: PASS. Guest boot arguments end in 'pdm1kbd=1 pdm1trackpadenum=1 pdm1trackpadchild=1'. desktop_enabled and native_trackpad_child_enabled are true. native_keyboard_desktop, dart_survey, trackpad_enumeration, virtual_input, keyboard and terminal_input opt-ins are false. No host-HID path is enabled.

notes: The criteria file (9477795a) was checked only for binding, not graded or reviewed here.
Source residuals from reports/sprint-010/trackpad-input-trace-source-review.json still apply: the hex buffer is not zero-initialized (unreachable case), and IOLog output delays dispatch briefly.
DL24 lines may interleave with the unchanged LIVE120 exports. Any LIVE grading result stays separate from the raw DL24 proof.
scope: Read-only: hashes, file comparison with live001, KC fileset parsing of both kernels (entry-relative sections), llvm-nm and llvm-objdump of both bundles, normal_image.verify_manifest and host_progress opt-in reads. No SSH, hardware, Nix or build.
